tracks.name: Frontend Web Track
tracks.description: Master HTML5, CSS3, Modern ES6 JavaScript, React, Tailwind, animations, and responsive layouts.

tracks.name: Backend Java Track
tracks.description: Learn Core Java, OOPs, Spring Boot REST APIs, JPA Hibernate, Gradle, PostgreSQL, and security.

tracks.name: DevOps & Cloud Track
tracks.description: Understand Linux bash scripting, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and AWS Cloud deployments.

achievements.name: First Commit
achievements.desc: Pushed your first day of code to GitHub.

achievements.name: 7-Day Warrior
achievements.desc: Maintained an active streak for 7 consecutive days.

achievements.name: Late-Night Owl
achievements.desc: Submitted proof of work between 11 PM and 2 AM.

testimonials.name: Rohan Mehta
testimonials.text: The consistency ABTalks forced in me was unreal. Pushing a commit and writing a LinkedIn update every day for 60 days made recruiters reach out to me instead of me cold applying. Got placed as a React Developer at a fintech startup!

testimonials.name: Sneha Gupta
testimonials.text: I used to learn in bursts and quit. The gamified streak ring and night-owl alerts kept me going when I was tired after college labs. Completing the Spring Boot module gave me the confidence to build real systems.

challengeDays.title: Git Started & Workspace Setup
challengeDays.description: Set up your Git workspace, sign in to GitHub, create a repository named 'abtalks-60-day-challenge', and submit your first markdown README file detailing your track goals.
challengeDays.challenge: Create a repo, add README.md, commit, push, write a LinkedIn post stating your track choice, and submit links.

challengeDays.title: HTML5 Semantics & Structure
challengeDays.description: Build a semantic personal resume webpage using standard HTML5 tags like header, section, footer, article, nav, and main.
challengeDays.challenge: Write clean HTML with no inline styling, validate your markup, commit, and post your resume screenshot.

challengeDays.title: CSS Variables & Layouts
challengeDays.description: Style your resume website using custom CSS variables for theme colors, margin hierarchies, and clean box model configurations.
challengeDays.challenge: Define a dark/light color palette inside :root and style the resume to look modern and readable.

challengeDays.title: Responsive Design & Flexbox
challengeDays.description: Utilize CSS Flexbox rules to convert your resume sections into auto-fitting layouts that scale beautifully on a 390px mobile viewport.
challengeDays.challenge: Ensure no text overflows, buttons adjust size, and layout shifts to single-column on mobile screen limits.

challengeDays.title: CSS Grid & Dashboard Layouts
challengeDays.description: Implement CSS Grid properties to develop a dashboard template card containing status updates, progress bars, and calendar widgets.
challengeDays.challenge: Use grid-template-areas to layout cards neatly and keep elements fully aligned on mobile.

challengeDays.title: JavaScript ES6 Essentials
challengeDays.description: Explore new JavaScript syntax features including destructuring, template literals, arrow functions, and array methods (map, filter, reduce).
challengeDays.challenge: Solve a set of 5 algorithmic data manipulation exercises using ES6 features without writing traditional loops.

challengeDays.title: DOM Manipulation & Event Listeners
challengeDays.description: Interact with webpage HTML elements programmatically: handle input typing, listen to click events, and modify text content on the fly.
challengeDays.challenge: Build an interactive list builder that lets users add, check-off, and remove text tags with animations.

challengeDays.title: Simple Interactive Calculator
challengeDays.description: Assemble a functional math calculator that registers button presses, evaluates simple expressions, and showcases results.
challengeDays.challenge: Avoid using eval(). Handle edge cases like division by zero and input decimal validation.

challengeDays.title: Local Storage & Persistence
challengeDays.description: Save web page application settings locally so user configurations survive browser refreshes or close operations.
challengeDays.challenge: Persist a to-do list items array to localStorage and load it back on document startup.

challengeDays.title: Asynchronous JavaScript & Promises
challengeDays.description: Understand execution delays, async/await wrappers, promise states, callbacks, and handling network timeouts.
challengeDays.challenge: Create a dummy fetch utility that resolves after 2 seconds or rejects if a random number check fails, handling errors gracefully.

challengeDays.title: Fetch API & Public REST Endpoints
challengeDays.description: Send network HTTP requests to retrieve information from public APIs and display it in raw JSON or simple blocks.
challengeDays.challenge: Fetch data from the JSONPlaceholder API and display a list of 10 users in a simple grid.

challengeDays.title: GitHub Profile Explorer UI
challengeDays.description: Develop a single-page card viewer that queries the public GitHub API for a user, displaying their avatar, repositories, follower counts, and starred repos in a premium glassmorphic grid.
challengeDays.challenge: Create an input field for a GitHub username, pull user profile via Fetch API, render repositories sorted by stars, and handle errors for non-existent users gracefully.

challengeDays.title: Debouncing & Search Optimization
challengeDays.description: Add time-delay triggers on search bar keyboard typing to minimize redundant API fetch calls during typing.
challengeDays.challenge: Implement a 300ms debounce interval helper to filter a local mock user names list dynamically.

challengeDays.title: ChartJS Data Visualizations
challengeDays.description: Incorporate charting packages to visualize student performance metrics on canvas-drawn dynamic charts.
challengeDays.challenge: Render a bar chart of 6 tracks completion percentage and a line chart of daily commute times.

challengeDays.title: Interactive Weather App UI
challengeDays.description: Communicate with OpenWeatherMap APIs to fetch city coordinates and render live temperatures, humidity, and custom sky icons.
challengeDays.challenge: Integrate geolocation browser APIs to load weather details automatically for the student's current location.

challengeDays.title: Custom Audio Player Controls
challengeDays.description: Construct custom styling skins for standard HTML5 audio elements including progress scrubber, play buttons, and volume bars.
challengeDays.challenge: Bind standard audio tag methods (play, pause, duration, currentTime) to custom CSS-styled elements.

challengeDays.title: Regex Form Validator
challengeDays.description: Write complex regular expressions to validate user input details on registration forms (email, strong passwords, URL structures).
challengeDays.challenge: Provide real-time validation feedback to users as they type, color-coding input borders in response.

challengeDays.title: Kanban Board Drag & Drop
challengeDays.description: Design an interactive project status board with multiple columns (To Do, In Progress, Done) and draggable task cards.
challengeDays.challenge: Use HTML5 Drag and Drop APIs or custom mouse events to move cards across columns and save states to localStorage.

challengeDays.title: Theme Controller & Light Mode
challengeDays.description: Add configuration toggles allowing users to shift styles smoothly from dark space mode to sleek high-contrast light mode.
challengeDays.challenge: Use CSS variables, custom root classes, and persist selected theme states across sessions.

challengeDays.title: Introduction to React & Vite Setup
challengeDays.description: Initialize a React template project using Vite bundlers. Understand components,JSX markup, and folders.
challengeDays.challenge: Configure a React project, delete templates, create your first component showing local time.

challengeDays.title: React State & Props
challengeDays.description: Define dynamic states using useState hooks. Pass properties across component trees.
challengeDays.challenge: Build an dynamic item counter that accepts minimum and maximum threshold properties.

challengeDays.title: Handling Forms in React
challengeDays.description: Control inputs, select boxes, and textareas using component state attributes. Handle submit validation rules.
challengeDays.challenge: Develop a multi-step user survey form that gathers track details and stores inputs in a single object.

challengeDays.title: useEffect Hooks & Backend APIs
challengeDays.description: Handle lifecycle side effects. Pull data from APIs when components mount and clean up listeners.
challengeDays.challenge: Fetch data from a public endpoint inside useEffect and handle loading/error UI states.

challengeDays.title: React Context API for Global State
challengeDays.description: Provide globally shared state values without passing variables manually down multiple component levels.
challengeDays.challenge: Create a UserProfileProvider to store the active user configuration and display it in separate header/footer elements.

challengeDays.title: Custom React Hooks
challengeDays.description: Refactor reusable stateful logic out of components and bundle them in custom hooks (e.g. useFetch, useLocalStorage).
challengeDays.challenge: Code a useWindowSize hook that listens to resizing events and exposes current width/height parameters.

challengeDays.title: Tailwind CSS Integration
challengeDays.description: Install Tailwind utilities inside Vite. Style React widgets using utility classes directly.
challengeDays.challenge: Redesign your resume page from Day 2 using Tailwind utility classes.

challengeDays.title: Framer Motion Animations
challengeDays.description: Build high-fidelity fluid transitions, hover expansions, slide animations, and exit states in React.
challengeDays.challenge: Animate a modal layout so it pops up, fades-in, and scales down smoothly when closed.

challengeDays.title: React Router Setup
challengeDays.description: Install react-router-dom. Define client-side paths and structure core links.
challengeDays.challenge: Map separate URLs for Home, Projects, and Contact pages, and compile navigation paths.

challengeDays.title: Dynamic Route Parameters
challengeDays.description: Read dynamic route parameters from paths (e.g., /project/:id) to retrieve specific item details.
challengeDays.challenge: Map a detail page that reads a project's id from the URL and fetches metadata corresponding to that id.

challengeDays.title: Mid-Term Capstone: Portfolio App
challengeDays.description: Combine frontend skills to build a complete portfolio website containing about, projects showcase, dynamic navigation, and responsive layouts.
challengeDays.challenge: Assemble your portfolio, optimize performance, and deploy it to a live hosting service (Vercel).

challengeDays.title: Node.js & NPM Fundamentals
challengeDays.description: Install Node runtime environment. Understand require/import statements, core system modules, and package dependencies.
challengeDays.challenge: Write a node script that parses files in a folder and saves their sizes to a summary JSON log.

challengeDays.title: Express.js Basics & Routing
challengeDays.description: Create a basic HTTP server using Express.js framework. Map REST routes for GET, POST, and DELETE requests.
challengeDays.challenge: Build an Express server returning a JSON list of challenge tracks at /api/tracks.

challengeDays.title: Middleware in Express
challengeDays.description: Understand request interception, logging middlewares, error handlers, and parsing JSON request bodies.
challengeDays.challenge: Write a custom logging middleware that outputs current timestamp, HTTP verb, and response durations for each request.

challengeDays.title: REST API Design Best Practices
challengeDays.description: Structure API models logically. Return proper HTTP response status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, 500) and headers.
challengeDays.challenge: Develop an endpoint with parameter validations that returns 400 bad request if parameters are empty.

challengeDays.title: MongoDB & Mongoose Schemas
challengeDays.description: Establish cluster connections with MongoDB Atlas. Create schema objects using Mongoose ODM libraries.
challengeDays.challenge: Define a StudentSchema mapping name, streak, track, and completed array fields.

challengeDays.title: CRUD Operations with MongoDB
challengeDays.description: Implement complete Create, Read, Update, and Delete actions on MongoDB data documents inside controllers.
challengeDays.challenge: Create API endpoints to dynamically add, edit, fetch, and delete tasks.

challengeDays.title: Authentication: JWT & Bcrypt
challengeDays.description: Hash student password credentials using bcrypt. Generate signed JWT tokens upon login.
challengeDays.challenge: Code user registration and sign-in handlers that return auth tokens to clients.

challengeDays.title: Authorization Roles in Express
challengeDays.description: Write authorization middleware functions that limit access to specific routes depending on credentials.
challengeDays.challenge: Restrict access on /api/admin paths to admin tokens only, returning 403 Forbidden for students.

challengeDays.title: Uploading Files with Multer
challengeDays.description: Handle multipart form submissions to upload image assets to backend folders.
challengeDays.challenge: Build a profile avatar upload endpoint that saves files to a local uploads directory.

challengeDays.title: Full Stack MERN Integration
challengeDays.description: Connect your React frontend project to retrieve data from your Node Express API server.
challengeDays.challenge: Integrate React dashboard components to list real tasks retrieved from Express MongoDB servers.

challengeDays.title: Introduction to SQL & PostgreSQL
challengeDays.description: Install PostgreSQL database clusters locally. Learn SQL queries to build tables and insert values.
challengeDays.challenge: Create tables for students and tracks, and write raw SQL insert commands.

challengeDays.title: SQL Joins & Relationships
challengeDays.description: Understand foreign key constraints, one-to-many relationships, and querying tables using INNER JOIN syntax.
challengeDays.challenge: Query students and merge their track names using INNER JOIN commands.

challengeDays.title: Spring Boot Java Setup
challengeDays.description: Configure Java Gradle project, understand Spring architecture annotations, and start local servers.
challengeDays.challenge: Initialize Spring Boot project, define a basic REST controller, and boot it on port 8080.

challengeDays.title: Spring Boot REST Controllers
challengeDays.description: Map paths using @GetMapping, @PostMapping, and @RequestBody. Handle HTTP status codes.
challengeDays.challenge: Code a ChallengeController exposing endpoints to fetch profile lists.

challengeDays.title: Spring Data JPA & Hibernate
challengeDays.description: Map database tables to Java entity classes, create repository interfaces, and search records dynamically.
challengeDays.challenge: Create a Task Entity class, establish repositories, and save tasks to H2 databases.

challengeDays.title: Spring Boot Dependency Injection
challengeDays.description: Understand @Service, @Component, and @Autowired annotations to share service instances across objects.
challengeDays.challenge: Refactor database fetch queries out of controllers and bundle them inside a modular ChallengeService.

challengeDays.title: Unit Testing in Spring Boot (JUnit)
challengeDays.description: Write JUnit test methods to verify backend calculations and controller mapping outputs.
challengeDays.challenge: Write test cases checking if getTask() returns correct status on day 12 task lookup.

challengeDays.title: Docker Containerization Basics
challengeDays.description: Write custom Dockerfile configurations, compile app images, and execute container environments.
challengeDays.challenge: Create a Dockerfile bundling your Spring Boot JAR, run it, and access port 8080.

challengeDays.title: Docker Compose for Multi-Containers
challengeDays.description: Orchestrate multi-container setups linking frontend apps, backend APIs, and database engines.
challengeDays.challenge: Write a docker-compose.yml file mapping your backend, frontend, and PostgreSQL services.

challengeDays.title: GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipelines
challengeDays.description: Automate testing, package building, and deployment workflows using GitHub Actions configuration files.
challengeDays.challenge: Write a workflow file (.github/workflows) that compiles the backend and runs checks on git push.

challengeDays.title: Deploying to AWS S3 & CloudFront
challengeDays.description: Deploy compiled static React assets to AWS S3 buckets and configure CloudFront CDNs for worldwide edge delivery.
challengeDays.challenge: Upload build files to S3, hook up CloudFront distribution, and access custom DNS layouts.

challengeDays.title: Deploying Backend to AWS EC2
challengeDays.description: Provision AWS EC2 virtual machines, clone repository, configure Java/Node runtimes, and execute backend servers.
challengeDays.challenge: Launch EC2, configure security groups mapping port 8080, and run Spring Boot bootJar in the background.

challengeDays.title: Nginx Reverse Proxy Setup
challengeDays.description: Configure Nginx server rules to act as a reverse proxy, mapping public port 80 to backend port 8080.
challengeDays.challenge: Install Nginx, modify default configuration mapping /api requests to localhost:8080, and reload settings.

challengeDays.title: Redis Caching Layer Basics
challengeDays.description: Install Redis clusters. Cache frequently queried REST API data responses in memory to lower database query overhead.
challengeDays.challenge: Configure Redis in Spring Boot, cache task retrieval lookups, and observe speed improvements.

challengeDays.title: WebSockets and Live Communication
challengeDays.description: Implement live bi-directional server communication channels using WebSockets protocols.
challengeDays.challenge: Build a live co-working ticker overlay that outputs live commit submissions as they occur.

challengeDays.title: Performance Profiling & Lighthouse
challengeDays.description: Audit web pages using Google Lighthouse, analyzing image optimization, script load times, and compression styles.
challengeDays.challenge: Verify dashboard page speeds, compress CSS codes, optimize SVG icons, and achieve a 95+ score.

challengeDays.title: SEO Optimization & Meta Tags
challengeDays.description: Apply SEO tags, set up schema markup, and define meta descriptions to boost public search visibility.
challengeDays.challenge: Implement dynamic title tags and descriptive tags on all landing pages.

challengeDays.title: Jest and React Testing Library
challengeDays.description: Write automated test specifications verifying component click states, input text boxes, and API rendering states.
challengeDays.challenge: Code testing checks validating if submit triggers verification error when text boxes are empty.

challengeDays.title: Final Deployment & Custom Domains
challengeDays.description: Purchase domain configurations, assign nameservers, configure DNS records, and assign free SSL certificates using Let's Encrypt.
challengeDays.challenge: Deploy final applications, tie domain names, verify HTTPS access, and check loading states.

challengeDays.title: Capstone Project Showcase
challengeDays.description: Complete the 60-day coding journey! Showcase your final platform portfolio link to recruiters and share your milestone accomplishment on LinkedIn.
challengeDays.challenge: Gather all commitments, build final resumes, draft recap posts, and submit links.
